description: Bounded source-derived GNU Go suicide move predicate, including its single-stone ko-takeback condition.

fields: opponent move color 1 or 2, distinct from own
ko point row-major index -1 for none or 0..360
input.board: 19x19; omitted cells are empty; candidate location must be empty before the move

values.1: source rejects suicide or the specified single-stone ko recapture

workspace.meaning: Fixed board, visited/liberty state, and bounded traversal storage; implementations may use equivalent fixed storage. The 120-stone bound keeps every connected group’s maximum possible liberty count below the source's unsigned-byte l[][] wrap boundary.
